about_the_game:
Listen to the soundtrack of the remake of the classic BL Visual Novel, Sleepover: reWake! This soundtrack features six (6) tracks created by the game's original composer, nostraightanswer, back in 2014 and freshly balanced for re-release!

Not only that, but also receive four (4) versions of Afraid - the original opening theme, written & composed by KENO and performed by Kazou, as seen in the game's opening video! The audio has been fully re-mastered in both the Lyrical and Instrumental versions, and the original version is included for that nostalgic flare!
